Prospect Subscription.instructions: Estimate the probability that only the individual prospect supplied in the state starts a paid subscription within 30 days of trial start. Use its engagement, purchasing authority, budget approval, competitive interest, and shared historical context. Do not copy the historical fraction or estimate a cohort average. Return its single Bernoulli success probability; the application calculates the Poisson-binomial distribution locally.

criteria.true: The prospect starts a paid subscription within 30 days of its trial start, including day 30.
criteria.false: The prospect does not start a paid subscription within 30 days of its trial start.
